name: Common Addons for Elementor by Xpertcodes
author: xpertcodes

sections.description:
Common Addons for Elementor is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that extends Elementor page builder with a collection of professional, customizable widgets. Create beautiful websites with ease using our premium-quality widgets.

Features

  • Slider Widget – Create stunning image sliders with customizable controls, autoplay, and navigation
  • Custom Header Widget – Design custom headers with logo, navigation menu, and call-to-action buttons
  • Custom Footer Widget – Build professional footers with multiple columns, links, and copyright information
  • Hero Section Widget – Create eye-catching hero sections with background images, overlays, and multiple buttons
  • CTA Box Widget – Design effective call-to-action boxes with icons, text, and buttons
  • Testimonials Widget – Display customer testimonials with ratings, author information, and images
  • Pricing Table Widget – Create beautiful pricing tables with features, buttons, and featured plan options

Development

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please visit our GitHub repository to contribute.

Reporting Issues

If you find any bugs or have feature requests, please report them on our support forum or GitHub issues page.

Credits

Developed by XpertCodes
Built for the WordPress and Elementor community
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Common Addons for Elementor”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”
  5. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  6. Click “Activate”

After Installation

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  2. Go to any page and click “Edit with Elementor”
  3. Look for the “XpertCodes” category in the widget panel
  4. Drag and drop any widget to your page
  5. Customize the widget settings as needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin requires Elementor to be installed and activated. Elementor is a free page builder plugin available in the WordPress repository.

Can I use these widgets on any theme?

Yes, these widgets are designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.

Are the widgets responsive?

Yes, all widgets are fully responsive and will adapt to different screen sizes automatically.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes, all widgets include extensive styling options in the Elementor editor, including colors, typography, spacing, and more.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready and includes a .pot file for translators.
